create_cb_trainer_subclass: create a subclass of BaseCBTrainerWithEval that implements the cb_training_step method for a custom contextual bandit model
attach_eval_module: attach an offline evaluation module to a BaseCBTrainerWithEval instance to track reward during training
run_training_step: run the training step on a CBInput batch with optional offline evaluation and recmetrics logging
check_input_batch: check that a CBInput batch has valid 3D context arm features, labels, and actions before training
update_recmetrics: update torchrec metrics with model predictions, labels, and weights at configured logging intervals
